summary: The Supply Agreement between MediWound Ltd. and Challenge Bioproducts Corporation Ltd. (CBC) was originally signed on January 11, 2001, and amended on February 28, 2010. The agreement outlines the terms under which CBC will supply Bromelain SP, a raw material derived from pineapple stems, to MediWound for the production of a pharmaceutical product for burn treatment. The agreement includes provisions for exclusivity, manufacturing standards, pricing adjustments, and confidentiality.
contract_scope: Supply of Bromelain SP by CBC to MediWound for the production of a pharmaceutical product. Includes exclusivity, manufacturing standards, and pricing adjustments.

clauses.summary: MediWound may terminate the agreement with six months' notice, and CBC may terminate with twenty-four months' notice or more, depending on MediWound's ability to secure alternative supplies.

CBC must maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information received from MediWound, with obligations extending five years post-termination, except for product-related intellectual property which remains confidential indefinitely.
CBC agrees to defend and assume responsibility for any third-party claims that MediWound's use of Bromelain SP infringes on patents or other rights.
CBC commits to supplying Bromelain SP exclusively to MediWound, prohibiting the supply to any third parties for competing products.
CBC must adhere to specified manufacturing standards and allow MediWound to inspect facilities to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
